title: Thai Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai chicken curry made with coconut milk and served with steamed rice.

ingredients.name: gaeng curry paste
ingredients.notes: sambal oelek or red curry paste can be substituted

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat or low-fat, depending on preference

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce (if using) and salt. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro and basil.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
